platformSummary: Windows and Linux are supported. Release 1.3.14 passes source, installation and process gates on both; Chromium component screenshot acceptance passes on both with the unchanged 1.3.12 adapter. The selected Windows installation also passes actual MCP capture after service-only deployment.
extensionSummary: The Chrome Web Store serves Chrome adapter v1.3.12, compatible with service 1.3.14. Its candidate archive is byte-identical to the previous public release. The existing injector loads the installed service runtime without an extension update or reload. Compatibility is recorded in compatibility.json.
